prefect.name: Prefect
prefect.summary: Python functions become workflows, with a free Hobby plan to start on.
prefect.bestWhen: your team writes Python and wants a free plan to try first.
prefect.watchOut: the free plan keeps run history for only 7 days, and Team costs $100 per user a month.

dagster.name: Dagster
dagster.summary: Built around assets, so you can see which table came from which job.
dagster.bestWhen: you want lineage from day one and your team writes Python.
dagster.watchOut: credits are harder to forecast, and we did not find how many each plan includes.

airflow.name: Apache Airflow
airflow.summary: Free, open-source Python workflows with the most hosting choices in this list.
airflow.bestWhen: your team writes Python and wants free software it can move between hosts.
airflow.watchOut: workflows are code, and the docs describe it for batch work.

kestra.name: Kestra
kestra.summary: Workflows as YAML files, with a free open-source edition and no flow cap.
kestra.bestWhen: people who do not write Python need to define workflows.
kestra.watchOut: Cloud and Enterprise prices are not published, and SSO, access control and audit logs are Enterprise only.

hosted.name: Hosted Airflow (Astro, MWAA, Google)
hosted.summary: Open-source Airflow with the servers handled by Astronomer, Amazon or Google.
hosted.bestWhen: you like Airflow but do not want to run servers.
hosted.watchOut: hourly billing keeps charging when nothing runs, and the top Astronomer plans are quote only.

stepfunctions.name: AWS Step Functions
stepfunctions.summary: A step-by-step workflow service inside AWS, billed per step with 4,000 free a month.
stepfunctions.bestWhen: you are all-in on AWS and your jobs are few or irregular.
stepfunctions.watchOut: it is built around AWS services, and every retry is charged as one more step.

adf.name: Azure Data Factory
adf.summary: Copying and scheduling in one Azure product, with event triggers.
adf.bestWhen: you use Azure and want one tool for copy and schedule.
adf.watchOut: Microsoft points new users to Fabric Data Factory, and the bill has several meters.

lakeflow.name: Databricks Lakeflow Jobs
lakeflow.summary: Workflow automation that runs inside your Databricks workspace.
lakeflow.bestWhen: your data work already lives in Databricks.
lakeflow.watchOut: it runs work inside Databricks, and its pricing page lists separate Premium and Enterprise rates.
